mapper.sql: select a.id, a.out_delivery_id, a.material_id, a.next_flag,a.predict_count,a.predict_receive_count, a.receive_count,a.small_predict_count,a.small_receive_count, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_out_delivery_detail a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.out_delivery_id, a.material_id, a.next_flag, a.predict_count, a.predict_receive_count,a.batch_code, a.receive_count, a.small_predict_count, a.small_receive_count, b.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time,a.dept_name, b.`type` , b.code as origin_code , m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName,m.specifications as materialSpecifications, tu.name as unitName from t_out_delivery_detail a join t_out_delivery b on a.out_delivery_id = b.id and b.next_flag = 1 and b.del_flag = 0 and b.delivery_module = 1 left join t_material m on a.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.next_flag != '1' and b.code like "%" #{originCode} "%" and m.code like '%' #{materialCode} '%' and b.type = #{type} and a.next_flag = #{status}
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_out_delivery_detail set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
